## Comparator E0 — A0mc (shared with v065)
The E4B QAT w4a16 base with **no adapter**, served with the matched template 855bbbbb by a new v066 runner derived from the v062 matched-context machinery (adapter-free serving; otherwise identical: capped sandboxes, admission receipts a3b4548b / 536e2c3e, canary rule, eligibility rule), 48 tasks × 3 decoding seeds, new names results/v066_A0mc_s{1,2,3}. Sealed (report.json + Boss reproduction) before any v064 or v065 arm is read; A0mc runs even if Stage 0 or the pilot stops v064 (v065 and the paper's QAT panel need it). Reported in the paper's QAT panel as the matched-template base row, descriptively; A0mc vs A0cap is a template difference across separate runs and is never a claim. A0cap v052 is cited, never used as the comparator.

definitions.think_rate: v032 producer M1: share of agent steps with a non-blank thinking event, i.e. non-empty returned reasoning
definitions.compaction_calls: audit.trace_items LLM calls; call k (1-based, k >= 2) is a compaction call when call k-1 prompt_tokens >= audit.THRESHOLD (14,336), the audit rule at audit.py:165-166; event availability is not re-evaluated
definitions.content_without_reasoning_calls: trace-observable proxy for responses without <channel|>: calls that directly follow a tool response of a previous call without visible text (the matched template prefills the opener there) and carry visible text but no non-blank thought; an empty thought followed by text looks the same, and a missing <channel|> with a bare tool call leaves no trace (reasoning None and "" both drop), so this count is an upper bound for the visible kind only
definitions.secondary: find_opener and repro_script_opener shares (M4), max repeat (M2.max_repeat), M5 silent and normal repeat rates: v042 paired effects on primary40, descriptive only
definitions.descriptive_rows: v051 M0mc, sealed v043 M0 and M1 (bf16 base) and A0-capped v052 primary40 three-seed means read from their pinned reports; no re-analysis, no contrast and no 2x2
definitions.scope: Reported for both slots, all48, per run and per task; descriptive, no threshold

method: v042 producer per-run summaries and v042 three-seed means (mean_three); no bootstrap, paired effect, CI or label is reported
limitations: Known-holdout exploratory intervention prompted by prior observations; not independent heldout confirmation.
One paired training seed; three decoding seeds do not establish training-seed generality.
Semantic deduplication against training data is unverified.
Empty-thought/scaffold masking has prior art including ThinkPack; no method novelty claim.
No claim that history dropping is harmless or that effects are specific to small models.
Observed thought text is not direct evidence of internal reasoning; secondary mechanisms do not establish causal mediation.
Historical A0/A1 comparisons remain descriptive; historical A1 initialization is not reconstructed.

A0mc is a descriptive base row (prereg v064-r2, Comparator E0): no PK reading, no contrast; the v055 M0qmc rows are the reproduced reference, not a comparator; A0mc vs A0cap (v052, default template) is a template difference across separate runs and never a claim; the descriptive rows (v051 M0mc, sealed v043 M0 and M1, A0-capped v052) are not contrasts and form no 2x2; known holdout.
